generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The `union` method in `Sets.java` now takes a varargs parameter for additional sets, but in `BaseRestHandler#handleRequest`, it is called with three separate arguments (`RestResponse.RESPONSE_PARAMS`, `ALWAYS_SUPPORTED`, `supported`). This will not work as intended because the varargs parameter will treat all arguments after the first as part of the array. The call should be modified to pass an array or use `Sets.union(Arrays.asList(RestResponse.RESPONSE_PARAMS, ALWAYS_SUPPORTED, supported))`.

review_comment: It felt right for `RestResponse` to specify which parameter(s) it consumed? not sure if this is the best way to go about it.
I think so - this is kinda short-term anyway whilst we look at consolidating the validation steps
